domain_conditions: N is an integer and N >= 3

admissibility_conditions: all primitive restrictions in N3-CELL-COMPLETE-MAJORITY hold
for each recognized proposer i, F_i is a probability distribution supported on A_i_star(nu)
A_i_star applies proposer-payoff maximization first and the authorized minimum-expected-H tie-break second
ballot strategies are pure even when proposer strategies F_i are mixed
no symmetry restriction is imposed across proposer identities
private_rule_records.selection_status: full family of identity-indexed F_i distributions on the authorized lexicographic argmax A_i_star is preserved; no symmetric or Markov restriction, no belief restriction, and no ad hoc or additional equilibrium selection is added

source_checks: N3-C01 weak vote cutoff and T^Y
N3-C02 complete H IC including nonpivotal y versus y+o_theta
N3-C03 proposer payoff for every feasible proposal and vote profile
N3-C04 P2 exhaustive reduction to E_i, S_i, P_i, and R_i(nu)
N3-C05 P0 full-pie result and strict elimination of on-path slack
N3-C06 P1 strict hedge dominance including off-path proposals
N3-C07 P1a no on-path passage without H with y>0
N3-C09 P2 equality boundaries and proposal tie-break
N3-C10 P2 D>0 eliminates deliberate rejection and slack while screening delay survives
N3-C11 proposal beliefs after every individual zero-probability proposal
N3-C12 P7 public H vote and off-path posterior
N3-C15 existence, completeness, identity-indexed multiplicity, and no ad hoc selection
N3-C16 strict o_1<1 domain restriction preserves the N3 correspondence on the remaining domain
N3-C17 strict beta<1 proves D>0; beta=1 is an excluded future face and no baseline formula imports it

unanimity.domain_conditions: m=2, nu=0, beta in (0,1), 0<o_0<o_1<1, and o_1<=y_bar<=1. Define a0=beta*(1-o_0)/2, z=beta*(1-o_1)/2, p=1-beta*o_1-z, u0=1-beta*o_0-z, q2=1-beta*o_0-a0, k2=max{0,1-beta*o_1-a0}, e2=z, s=z, and L2=max{k2,e2}.

private_rule_records.admissibility_conditions: Each proposer identity chooses one local option: low-only passage; pooling passage; delay when k2<=a0; or a low-only/delay proposal mixture when k2<=a0. Low-only support has beta*o_0<=Y_i<beta*o_1, x_j>=z, L2<=R_i<=u0, feasibility, and common (R_i,Y_i). Pooling support has Y_i>=beta*o_1, x_j>=z, L2<=R_i<=p, feasibility, and common (R_i,Y_i); equality R_i=L2 requires Y_i=beta*o_1. The local low-only/delay mixture uses R_i=a0 and Y_i=beta*o_0. Pooling never mixes locally with another branch.
private_rule_records.selection_status: Within each identity, accepted support has common tie-break-minimal Y_i. The low-only/delay mixture is retained only at equal proposer and expected-H payoffs. Pooling cannot mix locally with low-only or delay. No additional selection is imposed.

unanimity.domain_conditions: m=2 and 0<nu<=nu_2, where nu_2=(o_1-o_0)/(1-o_0). Define a0, z, d=(1-nu)*a0, g=d, p, q2, k2, e2=min{z,(1-nu)*q2}, s=(1-nu)*z, and L2=max{k2,e2}.

private_rule_records.admissibility_conditions: Pooling always exists. Its support has Y_i>=beta*o_1, x_j>=z, L2<=R_i<=p, feasibility, and common (R_i,Y_i). For nu<1, equality R_i=L2 is excluded exactly when L2=(1-nu)*q2<z; every retained equality requires Y_i=beta*o_1. Delay exists iff k2<=d. Each identity selects pure pooling or, when admissible, pure delay; no within-identity cross-branch mixture survives in this low N2 region.
private_rule_records.selection_status: Accepted support uses common tie-break-minimal Y_i. Low-H equality bounds are open as stated. Delay cannot mix locally with pooling, but different proposer identities may choose different pure local branches.

structural_invariants.majority_exclusion: retained as an admissible branch in the N3 source correspondence
structural_invariants.multiplicity: preserved atomically by source equilibrium IDs, payoff vectors, outcome distributions, and selection_status

selection_status.majority: full family of identity-indexed F_i distributions on the authorized lexicographic argmax A_i_star is preserved; no symmetric or Markov restriction, no belief restriction, and no ad hoc or additional equilibrium selection is added
selection_status.unanimity: Accepted support has common tie-break-minimal Y_i. Pooling and delay may share support only at proposer payoff z and H payoff beta*o_1. No additional selection is imposed.
selection_status.comparison: No equilibrium, branch, identity product, or payoff vector is selected by N6.
